robustness.method: Latin hypercube; independent uniform parasitic ranges
robustness.note: Scenario fraction under stated assumptions, not probability of laboratory success. Intervals include finite sampled extremes; not a proof over continuous bounds.

explanation: 15 stages keep charging at 83.33 kV/stage, below the 200 kV limit.
Every resistor is counted: 330 total parts across front and tail networks.
Ranking combines tolerance-normalized waveform error, component count, uncertainty and operating margin. Score 1.141; lower is better.
ML trust weight 0.00; out of distribution. No laboratory accuracy claim.

Rank 1 versus rank 2: compliance is ordered first, then interval containment, then the weighted cost (1.1413 versus 1.1419). This setup uses 330 parts versus 330; lower cost can trade waveform deviation against complexity and headroom.

warnings: Decision support only. Engineer verification and laboratory procedures remain required.
All trained models use supplied synthetic data. No measured laboratory validation has been completed.
Reference formulas assert crest = n × charge × efficiency. Curves reconstruct predicted metrics; the independent circuit cross-check can disagree.
Some hardware settings lie outside training support. Their correction is reduced or disabled and intervals have no calibrated coverage claim.

ranking_config.search_note: Bounded enumeration and shortlist simulation; no global optimality guarantee
